zh: 要让任意两点之间恰好有一条简单路径，选出的边必须构成一棵树，所以这就是在完全图上求最小生成树，边权是曼哈顿距离。
n 最多 1000，完全图约 50 万条边；不必把边都列出来排序，用不带堆的稠密 Prim 就能 O(n²) 完成：每轮把离当前树最近的点并进来。
维护 best[i] 表示点 i 到当前树的最小距离，起点设为 0、其余为无穷大。共做 n 轮：在未加入的点里挑 best 最小的点 u，把 best[u] 加进答案并标记 u；再用 u 到每个未加入点的曼哈顿距离去更新它们的 best。答案可能超过 32 位，用 64 位整数累加。
en: For every pair of points to have exactly one simple path, the chosen edges must form a tree, so this is a minimum spanning tree on the complete graph with Manhattan distances as edge weights.

With n up to 1000 the complete graph has about half a million edges. Instead of listing and sorting them, run dense Prim without a heap in O(n^2): each round adds the point closest to the current tree.

Keep best[i], the smallest distance from point i to the current tree: 0 for the start point, infinity for the rest. Repeat n times: among the points not yet added, pick u with the smallest best, add best[u] to the answer and mark u; then update best of every unadded point with its Manhattan distance to u. The total can exceed 32 bits, so sum it in a 64-bit integer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Run dense Prim on the complete graph: each time, add the unvisited point closest to the current tree, and update the other points' minimum Manhattan distances.

## Proof of correctness

In each round Prim picks the minimum edge crossing between the current spanning tree and the set of unvisited points. Adding that edge cannot create a cycle; after the update, every unvisited point still holds its minimum edge weight to the tree. After n rounds the result is a minimum spanning tree.

## Complexity

Time O(n^2), space O(n).
